intent: fix hook shebang: resolve py.exe dynamically instead of hardcoding C:\\Windows\\py.exe
notes: Field bug (per user report screenshot g1.png forwarded from another Gator user's Claude session): git hooks silently broken on per-user / Microsoft Store Python installs. Root cause: `_hook_shebang()` in both `src/gator_command/scripts/gator-update.py` and its template twin hardcoded `#!C:/Windows/py.exe -3`. That path only exists on system-wide ("install for all users") Python installs; per-user installs put py.exe under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Python\Launcher\py.exe`. Git-bash exec's the shebang, no interpreter, silent hook failure, pre-commit governance skipped.

Rewrote `_hook_shebang()` in both copies to resolve dynamically at hook-generation time: probe `shutil.which("py")` → `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Python\Launcher\py.exe` → `C:\Windows\py.exe`. Every candidate is space-checked because POSIX shebang syntax cannot quote paths with spaces (and `%LOCALAPPDATA%` expands to `C:\Users\<username>\...` which contains a space when the username has one). If no tier yields a usable spaceless launcher, raises new `HookShebangUnresolvable`.

Wrapped both `plan_hook_updates()` and `install_git_hooks()` (both copies) with try/except for `HookShebangUnresolvable`: on catch, print the exception's actionable message to stderr and return `[]` / `0`. Converts the pre-existing silent-hook-install-succeeds-but-hook-broken failure mode into a discoverable install-time error. Audited `gator-init.py::ensure_git_hooks` — it calls both wrapped functions, so the graceful-degradation is inherited without additional wrapping.

Rewrote `TestHookShebang.test_windows_uses_py_launcher` + `test_windows_platform_shebang` (both patched `shutil.which` + `os.path.isfile`). Added 3 resolver tests: `test_windows_prefers_shutil_which_when_spaceless`, `test_windows_rejects_spaced_which_result`, `test_windows_falls_through_to_windows_dir_when_earlier_tiers_spaced`, `test_windows_all_tiers_fail_raises_with_actionable_message`. Added new `TestUnresolvableShebangRefusal` class with 2 caller-refusal tests pinning the return-0/return-[] contract with actionable stderr.

Updated `.gator/charters/scripts-repo-lifecycle.md` `build_git_hook_wrappers()` entry: shebang no longer a fixed literal on Windows; added TRIPWIRE bullet on `HookShebangUnresolvable` as loud-refusal-not-silent-skip.

Updated `.gator/charters/scripts-cross-cutting.md` "Managed Hook Path Migration" TRIPWIRE: replaced the `#!C:/Windows/py.exe -3` literal claim with a description of the three-tier resolver; added a new "Shebang invariant" paragraph naming the spaceless requirement and the loud-refusal contract.

Plan: `.gator/vault/artifacts/2026-08-28-hook-shebang-py-launcher-resolution-plan.md` (r2, revised per whiteboard findings on r1: space-check every candidate, drop the unproven bare `#!py -3` last-resort in favor of the exception-driven refusal path).
Tests: base+hook suite 43/43, adjacent suites (test_layout + test_template_sync + test_update_entry_points + test_session_hooks) 116/116, total 159/159 clean.
